---
title: Cache the first-page catalog query
type: decision
status: confirmed
updated: 2026-11-02
---

## Decision

Cache the result of the first-page catalog query (the initial page of the product listing).

## Reason

The first page is the most frequently requested slice of the catalog, so serving it from cache avoids repeating the same query on every request and reduces load and latency for the common path.

## Scope

Applies to the first page of the catalog listing only; pagination beyond page one and cache invalidation strategy are out of scope of this decision and remain open.

## Status

Confirmed for the current work context as a local decision. Not promoted to canonical documentation; revisit if access patterns or invalidation requirements change.
